tt-ps.name: PS pneumatic shear, 16 ga × 52″
tt-ps.summary: The shear for a shop that already has compressed air: a pneumatic cylinder drives the cutting beam through 16 ga (1.5 mm) mild steel over 52″ at 40 strokes a minute, with no motor, no hydraulics and nothing to warm up. A low cutting angle cuts narrow strips without twisting; the bed and beam are aligned at the factory for accuracy; front and back gauges with fine adjustment, a mobile 24 V foot pedal and a complete pneumatic control set are standard. 1,257 lb, runs on 85 – 100 psi shop air.

Back gauge 29.5″ (750 mm) with indicator; front gauge 21″ (535 mm)
